title: Staphylococcus aureus Infections: Epidemiology, Pathophysiology, Clinical Manifestations, and Management

claims.text: In the industrialized world, Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia (SAB) incidence is 10 to 30 per 100,000 person-years.
claims.byte_quote: In the industrialized world, the population incidence of SAB ranges from 10 to 30 per 100,000 person-years

claims.text: MRSA bacteremia incidence in Quebec rose from 0 to 7.4 per 100,000 person-years between 1991 and 2005.
claims.byte_quote: in Quebec, Canada, the incidence of MRSA bacteremia increased from 0 per 100,000 person-years to 7.4 per 100,000 person-years from 1991to2005

claims.text: S. aureus is now the most common cause of infective endocarditis in the industrialized world.
claims.byte_quote: _S. aureus_ is now the most common cause of IE in the industrialized world

claims.text: The proportion of IE cases due to S. aureus rose from 24% to 32% between 1998 and 2009.
claims.byte_quote: the incidence of IE increased from 9.3 per 100,000 person-years in 1998 to 12.7 per 100,000 person-years in 2009. The proportion of IE cases coded as being due to _S. aureus_ increased from 24% to 32% between 1998 and 2009

claims.text: Age is a powerful determinant of SAB incidence, with highest rates at the extremes of life.
claims.byte_quote: Age is a powerful determinant of SAB incidence, with the highest rates of infection occurring at either extreme of life

claims.text: SAB incidence exceeds 100 per 100,000 person-years in those over 70 years of age.
claims.byte_quote: the incidence of SAB is >100 per 100,000 person-years among subjects >70 years of age

claims.text: Male gender is associated with increased SAB incidence (male-to-female ratio ~1.5).
claims.byte_quote: Male gender is consistently associated with increased SAB incidence...with male-to-female ratios of ∼1.5

claims.text: Invasive MRSA incidence in the US black population (66.5/100,000) is over twice that of the white population (27.7/100,000).
claims.byte_quote: In the United States, the incidence of invasive MRSA in the black population (66.5 per 100,000 person-years) is over twice that in the white population (27.7 per 100,000 person-years)

claims.text: SAB incidence in HIV-infected patients (494/100,000) is 24 times that of the non-HIV population.
claims.byte_quote: incidences of SAB in HIV-infected patients of 494 per 100,000 person-years...or 24 times that of the non-HIV-infected population

claims.text: Among HIV-infected individuals, low CD4 count is independently associated with SAB.
claims.byte_quote: Among HIV-infected individuals, a low CD4 count was independently associated with SAB

claims.text: Among injection drug users, SAB incidence is at least 610 per 100,000 person-years.
claims.byte_quote: the incidence of SAB was at least 610 per 100,000 person-years

claims.text: SAB incidence in hemodialysis-dependent patients ranges from ~3,000 to nearly 18,000 per 100,000 person-years across countries.
claims.byte_quote: The incidences of SAB in hemodialysis-dependent patients were 3,064 per 100,000 person-years in Taiwan, 17,900 per 100,000 person-years in Ireland, and 4,045 to 5,015 per 100,000 person-years in the United States

claims.text: The predominant risk factor for SAB in hemodialysis patients is the presence of an intravascular access device.
claims.byte_quote: The predominant risk factor for these patients is the presence of an intravascular access device

claims.text: In patients with a prosthetic cardiac valve who develop SAB, the risk of IE is ~51%.
claims.byte_quote: in one prospective cohort study of patients with a prosthetic cardiac valve who developed SAB, the risk of IE was ∼51%

claims.text: Recommended IV antibiotic duration for uncomplicated SAB is at least 2 weeks.
claims.byte_quote: The recommended duration of intravenous (i.v.) antibiotics for uncomplicated SAB is at least 2 weeks

claims.text: Daptomycin at 6 mg/kg IV once daily was noninferior to vancomycin for MRSA bacteremia.
claims.byte_quote: daptomycin at 6 mg/kg of body weight i.v. once daily was noninferior to vancomycin

claims.text: Higher daptomycin doses of 8 to 10 mg/kg are increasingly used and appear safe.
claims.byte_quote: higher doses (8 to 10 mg/kg) are increasingly being used and appear to be safe

claims.text: For complicated SAB, 4 to 6 weeks of IV therapy has been the standard practice.
claims.byte_quote: For complicated SAB, 4 to 6 weeks of i.v. therapy has been the standard practice

claims.text: Patients treated with vancomycin for right-sided IE should receive more than 2 weeks of therapy.
claims.byte_quote: patients being treated with vancomycin for right-sided IE should receive >2 weeks of therapy

claims.text: Tigecycline carries an FDA black box warning for increased risk of death versus other antibacterials.
claims.byte_quote: tigecycline has subsequently received an FDA black box warning for an increased risk of death compared to other antibacterial drugs

claims.text: Daptomycin nonsusceptibility developed in 5 of 45 MRSA bacteremia patients.
claims.byte_quote: Nonsusceptibility to daptomycin developed in 5 of 45 patients with MRSA bacteremia

claims.text: Common primary sources of SAB are vascular catheter-related infections, SSTIs, pleuropulmonary, osteoarticular infections, and IE.
claims.byte_quote: common primary clinical foci or sources of infection are vascular catheter-related infections, SSTIs, pleuropulmonary infections, osteoarticular infections, and IE

claims.text: No focus of infection is found in about 25% of SAB cases.
claims.byte_quote: a focus of infection is not found in ∼25% of cases

claims.text: Mortality varies by source: higher for bacteremia without a focus (22-48%), IE (25-60%), pulmonary (39-67%); lower for catheter-related (7-21%), SSTIs (15-17%), and UTIs (10%).
claims.byte_quote: higher mortality rates for bacteremia without a focus (22 to 48%), IE (25 to 60%), and pulmonary infections (39 to 67%), compared to lower rates for catheter-related bacteremia (7 to 21%), SSTIs (15 to 17%), and urinary tract infections (UTIs) (10%)

claims.text: Right-sided IE is usually secondary to injection drug use or the presence of a central catheter.
claims.byte_quote: Right-sided disease is usually secondary to either injection drug use or the presence of a central catheter
